description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductRelationshipDao interface, providing methods to retrieve product relationship data from the database using JPA queries. It handles various retrieval scenarios such as fetching by type, group, products, and store, often utilizing complex join fetch statements to optimize data loading.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for accessing ProductRelationship entities from the database, extending generic DAO functionality and implementing custom retrieval methods.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductRelationship based on store, type, product, and language, with native join fetch queries for optimized ORM retrieval.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships by store, type, and language, focusing on descriptions and related products.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Fetches product relationships belonging to a specific group, including related entities like attributes, descriptions, images, etc.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Gets distinct product relationships that are considered groups (e.g., relationship with null product), compiling results into a list without duplicates.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Fetches relationships of a specific type across the entire store.

methods.name: listByProducts
methods.description: Returns all relationships associated with a particular product, either as primary or related product.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves relationships filtered by store, type, and specific product.
